selection_metadata.cutoff_reason: q1ec2.row.005 is the first follower response after the route instruction containing the focus. It requests slower delivery but does not restate the landmark.

observer_input.overall_task: One participant describes a route, and another attempts to reproduce it on their own map. Their maps may differ, and neither participant can see the other's map.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: follower

subtask_hypotheses.description: Follow the initial route from START, including navigating around the intended plane-crash site.

focus.quote: the site of a plane crash
focus.why_selected: The landmark anchors a route instruction, while the first response addresses delivery speed rather than revealing which plane-crash landmark the follower has in mind.

supported_readings.reading: The giver is directing the follower around the lower-left plane-crash site on the giver map as part of the initial route.

participant_interpretations.uncertainty: The prefix does not show how the giver interprets the follower request beyond its surface request to slow down.

supported_readings.reading: The follower understood that instructions were being given but requested slower delivery.

participant_interpretations.uncertainty: The response does not establish which plane-crash site, if any, the follower linked to the expression.

consequence_analysis.subtask_hypothesis: Follow the initial route from START.
consequence_analysis.reading: The intended plane-crash landmark is not established for the follower at the cutoff.
consequence_analysis.affected_judgment_or_action: Which landmark to approach and circle.
consequence_analysis.expected_consequence: Unknown at cutoff; choosing the upper-right rather than lower-left plane-crash site would substantially change the route.

manual_annotation.rationale: The giver intention is supported by the instruction and route map, but the first response supplies no evidence of the follower landmark interpretation. A request to slow down is uptake of the instruction event, not evidence of a particular landmark grounding.
manual_annotation.selection_reason: Shows why task engagement without semantic uptake should remain unresolved at the first-response cutoff.

annotation_notes.existing_labels_used: Consulted after manual prefix analysis: human-verified q1ec2.ref.0 is pending/unaccommodated; the parallel LLM annotation is pending/unspecified. These labels were not included in observer_input.
annotation_notes.manual_additions: Generated transcript-row IDs, cutoff selection, prefix-only interpretation analysis, and consequence analysis. No text was added to or normalized within the verbatim transcript rows.
annotation_notes.limitations: The HCRC plain transcript supplies speaker roles and row text but no row IDs, so q1ec2.row.NNN IDs were generated in chronological file order. See row_crosswalk.csv for physical source lines. XML timing/utterance metadata is authoritative where needed. Word counts use whitespace-separated tokens. The two original task maps are privileged observer context under the proposed both-map condition. No completed follower map or path-deviation outcome was used. The focus is a substring of row.004; observer_input contains no focus marker.
